sources.title: The Architectural Record, July 1929: Albert Chase McArthur, The Arizona-Biltmore Hotel
sources.inspection: Read architect-authored construction description; individually inspected first, second, third and fourth floor plans and enlarged upper-floor plans, plus two original south-facade photographs. Published block module 18 by 13.5 inches and half unit 9 by 6.75 inches. Plans control relative core/room shapes, not unmeasurable scan scale. Current Qualla photographs take precedence for restored details.

Individually inspected complete official resort map. Main Building labels include Aztec Room, Gold Room and Grand Ballroom; later conference halls and named lodging wings are separately identified and excluded.

sources.facts: Opened 1929, restored after 1973 fire; later Paradise, Valley/Conference Center, East/Garden/Terrace Court and other wings identified. Supports scope separation rather than treating the whole modern resort as the original block.

notes: Prior attribution-licensed/current-site imagery excluded as current construction control. Factual dimensional/map provenance retained; inherited hidden masses remain approximate. Current leaf relief uses three exact Qualla public-domain originals.
